import * as echarts from 'echarts'

interface Point {
  label: string
  value: number
}

const data: Point[] = [
  { label: 'Jan', value: 12 },
  { label: 'Feb', value: 18 },
]

export const meta = {
  title: 'Monthly volume',
  kind: 'chart' as const,
  caption: 'Two months, one bar each.',
}

export function mount(el: HTMLElement, ctx: { theme: { text: string } }): () => void {
  const chart = echarts.init(el)
  chart.setOption({
    textStyle: { color: ctx.theme.text },
    xAxis: { type: 'category', data: data.map((point) => point.label) },
    yAxis: { type: 'value' },
    series: [
      {
        type: 'bar',
        data: data.map((point) => point.value),
        itemStyle: { borderRadius: 0 },
      },
    ],
  })
  return () => chart.dispose()
}
